proposal.cue: Ensure that command values are validated to reject whitespace-only inputs.
proposal.explanation: The original code allowed whitespace-only command values to pass validation, which led to failures in the eval task reader. The repair involved changing the validation logic to check for trimmed string length, thus rejecting invalid commands while preserving valid task data.
proposal.intervention: When a string must contain meaningful text, validate its trimmed length while preserving the original accepted value.
proposal.prediction: Future tasks that involve command validation will succeed if they implement similar input checks to ensure non-empty string values.
proposal.falsifiedBy: The validation logic does not reject whitespace-only command values.
